meta.first_line: nagara bhramiyā āmāra gaura ela ghare

text: nagara bhramiyā āmāra gaura ela ghare
gaura ela ghare āmāra nitāi ela ghare
dhūlā jhāri’ śachīmātā gaura kole kare
translation: After parikramā of the town, Gaurāṅga returns to His house, and Nitāi also comes to the house. Dusting off His body, Śachī Mātā takes Gaurāṅga upon her lap. Out of great spiritual joy all the devotees are chanting “Hari Hari!”
